flows.name: Sign up
flows.goal: Create an account to keep a private reading list.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses to sign up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the sign-up form.

steps.userAction: The visitor fills in the form and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the account, signs the reader in and shows their start page.

alternatives.condition: The email is not an address or the password is shorter than 8 characters.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The email already has an account.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says so and offers to sign in instead.

flows.outcome: The reader has an account and is signed in; after a refresh they are still signed in.

flows.name: Sign in
flows.goal: Get back to the reading list.

steps.userAction: The reader chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the sign-in form.

steps.userAction: The reader enters their email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the reader in and takes them to their reading list.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: The email and password do not match an account.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says so and keeps the email typed.

flows.outcome: The reader is signed in and stays signed in after a refresh.

flows.name: Add a book to the reading list
flows.goal: Remember a book to read later.

steps.userAction: The reader chooses to add a book.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty book form.

steps.userAction: The reader fills in the book and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the book and shows it first in the reading list.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the values and offers to retry.
Nothing is saved; the website shows the reading list as it was.

flows.outcome: The book is saved and is still there after a refresh.

flows.name: Browse and search the shelf
flows.goal: Find a book on the list.

steps.userAction: The reader opens their reading list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website lists the reader's books, newest first, each with its title, author and shelf.

steps.userAction: The reader types part of a title or an author.
steps.websiteResponse: The website narrows the list to the books that match as the reader types.

alternatives.condition: The reader has no books yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the list is empty and offers to add a book.
The website says nothing matched and offers to clear the search.

flows.outcome: Nothing changed; the reader has found the book they were after.

flows.name: Delete a book
flows.goal: Remove a book the reader no longer wants on the list.
preconditions: At least one book on the list.

steps.userAction: The reader opens a book from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the book's title, author and shelf.

alternatives.condition: The book was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the book is gone and shows the reading list.

flows.outcome: The book is gone and stays gone after a refresh.

flows.name: Sign out
flows.goal: Leave the reading list private on a shared device.

steps.userAction: The reader chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the reader out and shows the public start page.

flows.outcome: The reader is signed out; a refresh still shows the public start page.

fields.label: Email
fields.meaning: How the reader signs in and can be reached

fields.label: Password
fields.meaning: The secret that protects the reader's list

fields.label: Title
fields.meaning: How the reader refers to the book

fields.label: Author
fields.meaning: Who wrote it, to tell books with similar titles apart

fields.label: Shelf
fields.meaning: Where the reader is with the book

steps.userAction: The reader chooses to delete the book and confirms.
steps.websiteResponse: The website removes the book and shows the reading list without it.

alternatives.condition: The reader decides to keep the book.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is removed; the website shows the book again.

assumptions.text: Books are listed newest first; there is no manual ordering.
